editorialIntent: Country × Wildlife × Guyana. Compare three active multi-country Ada Tours programs by actual Guyana days vs Suriname wildlife itinerary: Kaieteur and Georgetown in Guyana; Peperpot, Upper Suriname and Kabalebo in Suriname. Explain included domestic Kaieteur flights, excluded Guyana-Suriname flights for 9 and 14 days, weather contingency, and Guyana wildlife habitats not actually visited.

externalSources.supports: Kaieteur waterfall 741 ft ≈226m, rainforest location on Potaro, flight from Ogle about an hour, short park tours, Guianan cock-of-the-rock and golden frog, cancellation risks from weather.

Wildlife habitats and observation possibilities in Rupununi, Iwokrama and Kaieteur; sightings must not be guaranteed.
Birding environments differ between rainforest, Kaieteur, inland savannah; Guianan cock-of-the-rock at Kaieteur.
Ogle/Eugene F. Correia hub for small aircraft into interior, luggage restrictions set by carrier, travel geography.
